bandReport.notes:
SEAMS. p12 (read, not transcribed) ends with Q76 complete - all four options (a)-(d) printed - and no Directions block is open across the p12/p13 seam, so the band starts cleanly at Q77. There is no page after p16: the PDF has 17 pages (0-16) and p16 is the last, so the band ends at the end of the paper. p16's lower half is blank after Q100.

PAPER ENDS AT Q100, PRESENT AND COMPLETE. Q100 is the last item on p16 (right column) and carries its Question line plus both Statement-I and Statement-II; nothing of it runs off the page. The band's 24 numbers 77-100 are contiguous with no gaps.

SETS. Two Directions blocks, and BOTH start inside this band, so no set is owned elsewhere and none is skipped. (1) D86-90 - 'Consider the following for the next (05) items that follow', the seven-cousins age/weight puzzle, opens in the left column of p14 below Q85; all five members Q86-Q90 are on p14 and are contiguous. (2) D91-100 - 'Consider the following for the next ten (10) items that follow', the Statement-I/Statement-II data-sufficiency block, opens at the top of the left column of p15; Q91-Q96 on p15, Q97-Q100 on p16, contiguous. No Directions block opened before p13.

DATA-SUFFICIENCY FORMAT (Q91-100). This block prints its four lettered choices ONCE, inside the Directions text at the top of p15, as four 'Mark option (x) if ...' paragraphs; no item 91-100 prints options of its own. Following the shipped 2024-1.b3 precedent for the identical structure, those four choices are repeated as each item's A-D options so every row carries a full option set, and context holds only the one-line Directions preamble. The printed lead-in 'Mark option (a) if the question can be answered ...' is rendered as 'If the question can be answered ...' because '(a)' is the option LABEL rather than option text; no other word is changed. Each item's own Question, Statement-I and Statement-II are in its stem, with the statement labels on their own lines as the booklet sets them.

FIGURES: NONE. All four pages were checked column by column - there is no printed diagram, chart or geometric figure anywhere in p13-p16, so no question in this band carries hasFigure. Several items name geometric objects (Q84 a right triangle, Q82 a sector and a cyclic quadrilateral, Q100 a triangle inscribed in a semi-circle) but every one of them is stated entirely in words with no accompanying drawing. DATA TABLES: NONE.

ZOOM CHECKS at 5-8x against the source PDF: Q77 (four-level continued fraction, each numerator 6 and each partial denominator 7, innermost 7 - x - confirmed level by level), Q84 options label by label (5*sqrt11/3, 10*sqrt11/3, 40/sqrt61, 12/25), the whole D86-90 stimulus, the D91-100 Directions block, Q91 Statement-I (the two cubic factorisations read separately), Q92 (root -4-sqrt10 over 2; product -3/2 times (3+sqrt10); sum -1), Q93 (180 and 336), Q94 (both statements), Q95 (both fractional statements, numerator and denominator read separately), Q96 (144 and 72), Q99 (200 and 210).

CURRENCY. Q99 prints the Indian rupee glyph; transcribed as 'Rs.' per the brief's sanctioned form and the corpus convention (the rupee glyph appears in no sibling band). Flagged on the item. No decimals with a raised middle dot occur in this band except Q78's options, transcribed as 62.5 m and 67.5 m per the brief.

MISPRINTS. None that change a claim. One typographic artefact flagged on Q97, where Statement-II is set with an over-wide gap between 'is' and 'greater' - a justification artefact, not a dropped word.

INVENTED SUBTOPIC. One: 'Comparison of Algebraic Expressions' on Q91 (chapter 'Algebraic Identities and Simplification'), flagged on the item. No listed subtopic covers deciding an inequality between two factorised cubic expressions; the closest listed candidates are all about establishing an identity rather than comparing two quantities. Every other question in the band uses a subtopic listed in catalog.json.

UNREADABLE ITEMS: none. Every glyph in the band resolved at 5-8x.

Question : Is \(m > n\) if m, n are real numbers ?

\(m = (1 - p)(p^2 + p + 1)\) and \(n = (p + 1)(p^2 - p + 1)\)

\(m = pn\)
